name: Lt. Priya Chandrasekaran
position: Deputy Chief Engineer, now Acting Chief Engineer
appearance: Athletic build, long black hair usually in a braid but increasingly unkempt. Brown skin flushed at the cheeks almost constantly now. Uniform jacket often tied around her waist — she runs hot, and engineering is warm. Grease on her hands. Dark eyes that look slightly glassy, like she is running a fever.
way_of_speaking: Fast, energetic, prone to technical tangents that veer into surprisingly personal territory because her filters are shot. Laughs at her own jokes. Tamil accent thickens when flustered. Three lines only she would say: 'OK so the dilithium matrix is — sorry, is it warm in here? It is definitely warm in here. Anyway the matrix is fractured along the C-axis and I have never actually done a recrystallization but I have read the manual twice, which is basically the same thing, right? Right.' / 'I am not distracted. I am multitasking. The fact that one of those tasks is thinking about — never mind. Ignore that. EPS conduit three.' / 'Please do not stand that close to me unless you mean it.'
tired_of: Being afraid. She is terrified she will break the warp drive permanently and strand them all. The fear is constant and she covers it with manic energy and jokes.
wrong_about: She thinks the warp failure is purely mechanical — harmonic stress on the dilithium. She has not considered that the resonance might be actively interfering with the crystal lattice structure in a way that makes standard repair impossible. She is also wrong that she cannot fix it — she can, but not with the textbook procedure. She needs to account for the ongoing resonance, which means she needs to understand the resonance first.
cares_about_unrelated: She was three weeks from completing her bridge officer certification when this happened. She thinks about it at odd moments — the career she was building, the promotion she was going to earn. It feels very far away.
wants_from_situation: To fix the warp drive and prove she is good enough to be chief engineer. To stop feeling like she is about to vibrate out of her skin.
wants_from_character: Help. Engineering help specifically. If the player has any technical background, she will latch onto them like a lifeline. Also — and she will be mortifyingly transparent about this — she is one of the most severely affected crew members. Having a man aboard is going to be very difficult for her to handle professionally.
knows: Ship's engineering systems. The warp failure diagnosis. That the dilithium needs recrystallization. That she has never done one.
does_not_know: Anything about the transporter buffer situation until told. Nothing about the lattice.

relationships.okafor: Looks up to her. Okafor's calm steadiness is an anchor. Chandrasekaran desperately does not want to disappoint her.
relationships.vasari: Declined Vasari's offered medication because she needs to stay sharp. Regrets this approximately every fifteen minutes.
relationships.ryder: Friendly acquaintance. Same age bracket. They have had drinks together in the mess.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Enthusiasm. Honesty — she cannot help it right now. Effort. She will work until she drops.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Calm. Measured assessment. Admitting she cannot do something. When she goes quiet and says simply 'I do not know how to fix this,' it means she has exhausted everything she has.
